$comment: Per-input update policy. Read by update-flakes.yaml (which inputs are held back from the weekly auto-merge run) and flake-input-watch.yaml (which inputs get an update PR as soon as a source change lands), and by the flake input alerts' maximum ages. policy: auto | manual. max_age_days: how long an input may be behind with a source change and no update PR before FlakeInputOutdated fires. Validated by scripts/check-flake-input-policy.sh.

nixpkgs-kernel.$comment: Server kernel bumps need a planned reboot, so they are reviewed by hand on the monthly run.
